about: What each Cell of a roster wears on a day, dealt from the kit's packs (kit/packs.json). `cells` are the Cells' codenames in the order they took their seats, the first-born first; `day` is the screen's month-day; `looks` is each Cell's pieces as `theme/piece`, the outfit theme's before the season's. `dress`, when a case has one, is the Mac's Settings › General › Outfit theme and Seasons; without it the Cells wear the house theme with Seasons on.

cases.says: out of season each Cell wears one house piece, no two the same
in a season each Cell wears the season's piece too, and the season's wins a slot both fill
a season's window holds its first day
a season's window holds its last day
the day after a season's window, its pieces are put away
a Cell alone wears its own first choice, whoever else might stand
where two seasons hold the day, the narrower one's pieces are worn
a season's window may run over the new year, holding its days on both sides
the day after the narrower window, the wider season's pieces are worn
a picked outfit theme deals from that theme in place of the house theme
a season's pieces are worn over the picked theme, the season's winning a slot both fill
with Seasons off only the picked theme is worn, in a season too
a theme the data does not hold as an outfit wears the house theme
